entries.19a62519d207ba8c: An electric power company that, with renewable energy at its core, handles electricity retail, power generation and the supply of biomass fuel.
entries.540f2f055e52e025: It sells electricity to corporate and individual customers. It offers fully fixed plans, hybrid plans, market-linked plans and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥91,326 million.
entries.8820e97caa015903: It sells biomass fuel, such as palm kernel shells and wood pellets, to biomass power generators of other companies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥22,750 million.
entries.8da79e056edd3393: Biomass power generators of other companies
entries.a4ae0b937b06f285: Income not included in the categories above. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,433 million.
entries.b6bcf872b990b8f4: It sells electricity through bilateral transactions and the Japan Electric Power Exchange. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,660 million.
entries.d5f7fffd1d96574c: Centered on renewable energy, it engages in electricity retail and wholesale and in wholesale of biomass fuel. It also operates power plants and handles fuel procurement and trading on an integrated basis. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥169,170 million.
